ctx.x: How did you like meeting Raymond Burke? Describe that for Paul.

Raymond Burke is, I hadn't heard him at all. I just heard that he's supposed to be the best white clarinet player in New Orleans. I met him yesterday and he said, I don't play much in front of public. I'm a bit afraid to. They all play too fast. I'm out of practice. I don't know what it is. If you think it's because I don't play very much these days that I find it hard to keep up with it. Well I answered what seemed to be logical. Naturally I suppose if you're out of practice you're going to find it hard to just…

I told him. Well what do you think about the personality of the men you've met in general in New Orleans? Have you met them a little bit and talked to them? Yes. Do you find them to be braggarts or do you find them to be modest or is there any rule or what?
